data.name: Devmani
data.gender_notes: Devmani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devmani is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Deva' meaning god and 'Mani' meaning jewel. This name signifies the goddess of gods, a radiant and divine being, and a source of grace and prosperity. The name Devmani carries the meaning “Goddess of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devmani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies divine grace and inner strength.
data.etymology: Devmani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devmani total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: देवमानी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) meaning 'God' and मानी (Mani) meaning 'Goddess'. So, देवमानी (Devmani) means 'Goddess of the Gods'.
